description: Mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood Hosted API for initial integration; after 4-week trial moving to Dedicated sizing & pricing conversations. Primary goal: predictable latency and unit economics for in-app assistant + search features.

notes: Customer snapshot: product analytics platform that surfaces contextual suggestions to product teams and a conversational support assistant embedded in-app.
Trial outcomes: integration straightforward; SDK + server streaming used for chat. No PII sent in staging data. Security team liked audit log hooks but requested KMS integration details.
Observed traffic (hosted trial): avg QPS 2.5, burst peak 12 QPS (replay), 95th percentile request concurrency ~6 during peaks.
Request mix observed during trial: ~58% chat/completion, ~30% embeddings/semantic-search, ~12% reranking/short prompts (these numbers vary by time of day).

Token mix & averages (measured from trial logs): chat prompt avg 260 tokens, chat response avg 190 tokens (total ~450 tokens/request); embedding payloads average 850 tokens per document; reranking small prompts ~60 tokens.

Latency & SLO: Product team requires P95 latency <= 200ms for short completions (<= 128 tokens) and P99 < 800ms for full flows; willing to trade-off some tail latency for lower cost on background reranking jobs.

Cost sensitivity: mid-market procurement — wants bounded monthly bill for Dedicated; target ARR math: prefer < $0.40 per 1k tokens served in steady state for chat-heavy routes when using Dedicated plus batching/caching.

Dedicated sizing (initial recommendation delivered): start with 2 x A100-style GPU nodes (or equivalent vCPU-backed smaller GPUs with heavy batching) configured as a dedicated pool with autoscale to +1 node for bursts; expected sustained throughput: ~20 QPS at 512-token average when using batching and KV prefix caching. Reserve burst buffer for 1.5x expected peak.

Traffic forecast (customer projection): month0 (post-trial) steady 5 QPS, month3 steady 20 QPS with 60 QPS peak, month12 steady 50 QPS with 150 QPS peak. Concurrency expected to track peak QPS with streaming sessions estimated at 0.6s per token; estimate 25-40 concurrent sessions at month3 peak.
Operational preferences: want VPC private endpoints for Dedicated, audit logs forwarded to their SIEM, SSO/SAML for team access, and monthly retention controls for debug traces.

Fallback strategy: prefer Redwood smart-routing — primary Dedicated pool, overflow to Hosted API for spikes >pool capacity with cost/latency policy. Also want model variant fallback to smaller quantized model if capacity constrained.

POC milestones remaining: security questionnaire completion (SEC-4182), legal SLA review, final pricing sign-off by procurement. SE to deliver performance runbook and expected cost-per-route by 2025-02-24.
Quotes: CTO — 'Need predictable monthly spend and predictable 95th latency. If Dedicated gets us within 10% of hosted performance at half the cost, we'll proceed.'

Open technical questions: exact kernel/quantization tradeoffs for embedding-heavy workloads, KV-cache hit-rate expectations for their prompt patterns, recommended batch sizes for reranking jobs to hit latency targets.
Next-step checklist: 1) CTO deep-dive (scheduled), 2) SE to present Detailed capacity vs cost table, 3) Prod legal to review SOC2 addendum, 4) Procurement to confirm ARR band and billing cadence.
